question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Advancement in science and technology in many areas ______ the lives of people more advanced than the ancient times.
solution:
The correct answer is **"has made."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in** present perfect tense**, indicating that the action started in the past and has continued up until the present.
 
• The correct form for present perfect tense is** "has/have + past participle."**
 
• **"Has made"** (singular verb) is the correct form for verb as it agrees with the subject 'Advancement' (singular subject).
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Advancement in science and technology in many areas **has made**__ the lives of people more advanced than the ancient times.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "was made"** is in the past tense, which does not fit the context of the sentence. It also implies that the advancements were made at a specific point in time and do not continue to impact people's lives.
 
• **Option 3) "is made"** is in the present tense, which does not fit the context of the sentence. It also implies that the advancements are currently being made, rather than having already been made.
 
• **Option 4) "have made"** is in the present perfect tense, but it is not in the correct form for the third person singular subject "advancement in science and technology." It should be "has made" instead.
